title.rendered: Archer Glen Food Drive for Elks

content.rendered:
Archer Glen has the opportunity to support the Sherwood Elks Lodge Holiday Food Basket Drive during the weeks of November 28th – December 9th. The food baskets will be delivered to families on December 17th. Our PAC will be running this event at the school.

Needed Food Items:

Paper Products

Applesauce

Jams & Jelly

Stuffing Mix

Canned Chicken

Pie Filling & Pie Shells/Crust Mix

Condiments

The Elks Lodge is hoping to help 150 families

Items can be brought to the classrooms or deposited in the lobby each day starting on Monday, Nov. 28th. PAC volunteers will be collecting the items and boxing them for pick up from the Elks Lodge on December 9th.
